reasons.persona_fit: Accurately targets the small business owner-operator with Bareni's calm, practical tone, restrained humor, human-in-the-loop emphasis, and strict compliance with the no-CTA rule.
reasons.clarity: Logical, clean progression from diagnosing date ambiguity in a workflow to assessing options and taking a concrete observational step.
reasons.actionability: Provides an immediate, low-overhead diagnostic exercise: tracking date-related workflow pauses over a one-week period before deciding on automation.
reasons.factual_grounding: Makes no fabricated customer, metric, or capability claims, staying strictly within diagnostic framing and approved boundaries.
